steps.description: The version each step runs at. A step left out runs at its oldest live version

anyOf.description: The step version to run, e.g. 2 for review@2

local.description: Path to the project's own step, from the project root

anyOf.description: A local step: the project supplies this step itself

paperTrail.description: Where the File step writes timesheets, memos and sign-offs

anyOf.description: This project keeps no paper trail

repo.description: owner/name of the repository the File step writes to

timesheet.description: Path of the timesheet: one JSON line per shift, its table in README.md beside it

signOffs.description: Folder for sign-offs: one JSON file each, in a folder per day

memoLabel.description: Label on each memo, an issue in the repository per machine per day

labelRenames.description: Old label names this project renames to factory labels, beyond the factory's own list, e.g. { factory: "kind:tooling" }
